name: Because I Love Her
source:
In Because I Love her you play as two main protagonists, John and Claire (names can be chosen upon intro), who live in a small city together alongside Claire's sister, Zoey. You've had things handed to you on a silver platter for quite some time, but money is beginning to run tight. During this journey together as a couple, you will find new ways to make money, develop a stronger (Or weaker) relationship together, all while dealing with everyday life that surrounds you. What seemed like a simple task later becomes harder than once thought as you learn more about those that surround you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2304170/Because_I_Love_Her/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《因为我爱她》中，你扮演两个主角，约翰和克莱尔（名字可以在介绍时选择），他们和克莱尔的妹妹佐伊一起住在一个小城市。很长一段时间以来，你一直在银盘上把东西交给你，但钱开始吃紧。在这段作为夫妻的旅程中，你们会找到新的赚钱方式，共同发展更牢固（或更弱）的关系，同时处理周围的日常生活。当你对周围的人了解得更多时，看似简单的任务后来变得比以前想象的更困难。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2304170/Because_I_Love_Her/]Steam[/url]]
